Class Stage.Builder

java.lang.Object
io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.Stage.Builder
Enclosing class:
Stage
public static final class Stage.Builder extends Object
Builds a stateless stage. state(Codec, Supplier) upgrades it to a stateful one.

    • ticks

      public Stage.Builder ticks(Duration interval, TickHandler logic)
      Declares ticks handled by stateless logic. Callable once.

      The runtime emits one stamped record per interval to the stage's own tick topic, consumes it back through the gate, and hands it to logic as a Tick. That topic is <application.id>-<name>-ticks, and must exist with the same partition count as the stage's widest source topic.

      Parameters:
      interval - how often to emit a tick
      logic - the logic to hand each tick to
      Returns:
      this builder, for chaining
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if ticks are already declared
      IllegalArgumentException - if interval is zero or negative

    • holdWarningAfter

      public Stage.Builder holdWarningAfter(Duration threshold)
      Sets how long a record may gate its channel before the runtime logs a WARN naming the missing cause. Defaults to thirty seconds.

      Zero or negative disables the warning, leaving CausalStreams.explainHolds() and the hold metrics as the interface. A hold is not an error. The warning says a wait has lasted long enough to be worth a look, and names what to look at.

      Parameters:
      threshold - the age at which to warn, zero or negative to disable warnings
      Returns:
      this builder, for chaining
